decision.observation: The car broke free: 6 mph in gear 1, red X cleared, two dots blue. It now sits on open grass in a corridor between pine clusters, headlight beam pointing up-screen toward a scattered line of red cones, a yellow tent/box, and a small lit vehicle ahead; the tarmac with blue puddles lies behind-left and the STOPP/Petrol banners on the upper-left verge.
decision.hypothesis: The cone-marked grass field ahead may be a slalom-style course section rather than off-course ground, since the red X cleared while crossing it. Straight throttle should carry the car toward the cones and the vehicle ahead.
decision.memory: W+D finally pulled the car out of the pine trap and onto open ground, clearing the X. A route through these cones may exist; the tarmac remains visible to the rear-left as a fallback.
